shared_scoring.metric: exp(total reference-solution token NLL / scored reference-solution tokens)
shared_scoring.format:
{{ bos_token }}Question: {{ messages[0]['content'] }}
Answer: {% generation %}{{ messages[1]['content'] }}{% endgeneration %}
shared_scoring.eos_policy: No appended EOS; prompt, BOS, overlap and padding contribute zero loss
shared_scoring.boundary_policy: Joint tokenization scores a token spanning the final prompt space and the first solution character
shared_scoring.aggregation: Token-weighted within each dataset; no aggregate across MATH-500 and GSM8K
